classification.difficultyReason: Apply the supplied ceiling definition and recognise that an integer is its own ceiling.

content.prompt:
Let $x\in\mathbb R$ and define $\lfloor x\rfloor$ and $\lceil x\rceil$ by
$$\begin{aligned}\lfloor x\rfloor&=\max\{m\in\mathbb Z\text{ where }m\le x\}\\\lceil x\rceil&=\min\{m\in\mathbb Z\text{ where }m\ge x\}\end{aligned}$$
These are respectively called the $\mathit{floor}$ and $\mathit{ceiling}$ of $x$. Find the value of $\lceil7\rceil$.

answer.worked: $7$ is itself an integer and is the least integer at least $7$. Therefore $\lceil7\rceil=7$.
